newsitem.title: USA: Continental orders GE Aircraft engines.
newsitem.headline: Continental orders GE Aircraft engines.

text.p: Continental Airlines said Wednesday it had chosen GE Aircraft Engines to power 35 new wide-body aircraft in an engine order valued by GE at more than $600 million.
The company said in a statement that it had selected GE's CF6-8OC2 engine to power the 30 767-400ER aircraft and the GE90 to power five 777 aircraft that it ordered last month from Boeing Co.
It said it had previously ordered five GE90-powered 777 aircraft and their delivery had been accelerated as part of its latest order.
Continental said the 10 new GE90-powered 777 aircraft will be delivered in September 1998 through May 1999, while the 30 767-400ER aircraft will be delivered in mid-2000 through the end of 2004.
